title: Unique Partner | AutoAgents.ai Raises Multi-Tens-of-Millions RMB Angel Round — AI Agents for Enterprise Services
summary: Welcome to another Unique Partner. AutoAgents.ai (未来式智能), founded June 2023, builds autonomous AI Agents and Copilot software for enterprise customers worldwide. Unique Research learns the company has closed a multi-tens-of-millions RMB angel round led by Sinovation Ventures
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Unique Partner welcome · December 26, 2023 · Unique Friend: AutoAgents.ai (未来式智能)

Welcome to another Unique Partner. AutoAgents.ai (未来式智能), founded June 2023, builds autonomous AI Agents and Copilot software for enterprise customers worldwide. Unique Research learns the company has closed a multi-tens-of-millions RMB angel round led by Sinovation Ventures (创新工场), with Gongqingcheng Qixi Investment (共青城七熹投资) participating. Proceeds go to product R&D, go-to-market, and team growth.

Team

R&D staff exceed 80% of headcount. Founder & CEO Yang Jinsong was product director at Alibaba DAMO Academy with deep AI product and commercialization experience. Core members come from DAMO, Tencent, ByteDance, Amazon AWS, and Google.

From paying for tools to paying for outcomes

Classic enterprise work trains people on many apps; hours vanish into search, data wrangling, and tool-hopping. Agents flip the model: staff state goals in natural language; Agents plan, log, and execute — humans keep key decisions. Yang’s north star is the LLM “last mile”: a new AI system architecture for human–Agent collaboration that targets 10× productivity for 1 billion knowledge workers worldwide.

Three product lines

Copilot — software-bound assistants that raise office throughput. Business auto-cruise — a new entry that absorbs business logic with little training. Autonomous Agents — fully autonomous understand → plan → execute → feedback loops. AutoAgents.ai claims the industry’s first autonomous-agent product proven in live scenes (e.g. 24/7 social-account planning and ops).

Model & traction

Main GTM: scene solutions for mid/large government and enterprise clients, plus high-value enterprise LLM products that cut delivery cost and cycle time. Deep partnerships with Tencent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, Innosen, and peers. Commercial orders already in the millions RMB; logos include State Grid, Antong Taikang, Offshore Oil Engineering, and a provincial HRSS bureau. Live projects: contract-review Agent, smart support, vaccine knowledge base, flight-booking Agent.

Investor note

Sinovation Ventures ED & Frontier Tech Fund GM Ren Bobing: AI Agents are a durable AI 2.0 landing path with rigid demand that will remake software architecture and interaction — and Sinovation already has multiple bets in the space. AutoAgents.ai’s product, Agent models, and frameworks are viewed as globally competitive; the firm expects Agents to penetrate every industry.

— END —
